description: Rework the whole Primary Advantage UX to match Tutor Advantage: brand tokens, one navigation, student home, redesigned student and teacher screens, accessibility, and loading/empty/error states.
deviation_notes: Daniel: the whole UX is janky, not only the theme. Tokens come from tutor-advantage apps/student-liff and apps/tutor-pwa globals.css. Do not copy Tutor faults: neutral-black shadcn primary, low-contrast tertiary text, indigo manifest color, English-only aria labels. New shared components go in packages/ui, not in local components/ui.
